Messages.Author: Katana
Messages.Body:
Evening,

The acting vampire gains 2 blood regardless if successfull, but does the targeted vampire lose 1 or 2 blood from a superior Loki's Gift + Hospital Food combination ?

Thanks in advance.

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:

Messages.Author: Kilrauko
Messages.Body:
> Katana wrote:
> Evening,
>
> The acting vampire gains 2 blood regardless if successfull, but does the targeted vampire lose 1 or 2 blood from a superior Loki's Gift + Hospital Food combination ?
>
> Thanks in advance.
>
1 as it is not tied to the amount of hunt and instead is clearly stated by cardtext to be "burn 1 blood". See difference between Kyoko's special ability and Loki's Gift wording.

Also, please use search in the future first as this has been answered, see  www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/79949-loki-s-gift-hunt-bonus#105914 another way would be to use  vdb.im/ searching for the card in question as it attempts to show all relevant rulings related to the card with hotlinks included to see the full context.

Or, if you're taking the time for a reply, you can also spend the 40 seconds it takes to search + copy/paste them in your reply and then spend the minute more to answer and perhaps another minute to teach a new player how to find information for themself instead being just snarky. Rules of the elysium and so forth.

Name: Loki's Gift [KoT:C/A2] Cardtype: Action Discipline: Protean +1 stealth hunt action. [pro] Hunt, and put this card on this vampire. This vampire can burn this card and 1 blood to get +1 stealth. A vampire can have only one Loki's Gift. [PRO] (D) As above, and burn 1 blood from any vampire. This vampire can burn this card as above, or can burn it during the polling step of any referendum to get +2 votes. Artist: Justin Norman

Name: Hospital Food [Anarchs:C] Cardtype: Master Master: unique location. Requires a ready anarch. Lock when an anarch announces a hunting action. If that action is successful, the anarch gains an additional blood. Artist: Christopher Shy

Name: Kyoko Shinsegawa [CE:V, BSC:X] Cardtype: Vampire Clan: Tremere Group: 3 Capacity: 5 Discipline: aus cel dom for Camarilla: Kyoko cannot hunt as normal. She may hunt by stealing a blood from another ready vampire as a +1 stealth (D) action. Artist: Max Shade Fellwalker

Trust in Jan Pieterzoon.
